## Spec

`docs/tickets/119_R2.13__audit-residual.md` — discharge the audit-trail
residual: DF-S1.15-3's open members (witness cosignatures, receiver receipts;
per-event blob encryption evaluated honestly — pure-std has no AEAD) plus
DF-S1.15-1's non-custody members (the `gc`/redaction emitters riding R2.2's
machinery, `lifecycle.escalation.*` where machinery exists). Custody-gated
members stay OPEN (ADR-0331 D3; OQ-170).

## Requirements

1. Witness cosignatures — `witness_cosignatures[{witness_name, key_id,
   timestamp, sig}]` over the landed checkpoint claim (the S-320 shape: a
   timestamped signature over the same note), multi-signer over the
   `AuditSigner` seam, declared via `witness_policy{required, witnesses[]}`
   on the manifest; custody stays external.
2. Receiver receipts — a receiver-signed record over an open-world effect,
   lifted into the run ledger as an `unverified`/`external` link; the
   `receipts` capability-vector entry is already declared (hh-hosting).
   Never a native-contract change (T-LCD-06/-07).
3. `gc`/redaction emitters — durable rows for every collection/redaction
   act at the R2.2 call sites (`lifecycle.ledger.gc`/`redacted` commit
   before bytes leave; `security.secret.redacted` producer audited).
4. Per-event blob encryption — honest assessment only; no AEAD in pure std
   ⇒ dated OPEN residual, never a fake cipher.
5. Custody-gated members stay OPEN (signed-checkpoint cadence/custody,
   real `signer_key_ids`, OQ-170).

## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-ledger/src/manifest.rs` — `WitnessPolicy{required,
  witnesses[]{witness_name, key_id}}` + `RunManifest.witness_policy`
  (emit-only-when-present, additive).
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/tree.rs` — `CheckpointClaim.witness_cosignatures`
  parse + `witness_sig_preimage(ts_ms ‖ checkpoint_sig_preimage)`.
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/audit.rs` — `WitnessSigner` trait (AuditSigner +
  `witness_name`), `NamedSigner` fixture, shared cosignature verification;
  `Auditor::check_claim` verifies cosig HMACs when a resolver is held;
  `audit_view` folds `witness_status` per checkpoint + a `receipts` fold.
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/store.rs` — `checkpoint_inner` gains a witnesses
  parameter; `checkpoint_witnessed`/`rotation_checkpoint_witnessed` mint
  `witness_cosignatures` (declared-pair + quorum gates); `verify_run`
  checks cosig shape/membership/HMAC + declared quorum; `record_receipt`
  mints `lifecycle.ledger.receipt` durable before returning.
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/receipt.rs` — the `Receipt` record codec +
  `verify` (`unverified`/`external` lattice, `external` ceiling T-LCD-07).
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — `lifecycle.ledger.receipt` audit-grade
  row registration.
- `crates/hh-embed` — `lab.receipt.record` boundary op (the Lab-facing lift).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0345` — owned decisions (cosignature construction,
  witness-policy home, receipt lift rule + status lattice).

## Test matrix

| AC | test |
|----|------|
| witness_policy codec + validation | `witness_policy_manifest_codec_round_trip_and_validate` |
| cosigned checkpoint mints + verifies (note + HMAC by hand) | `witnessed_checkpoint_cosigns_the_same_note_and_verifies` |
| sub-quorum / undeclared pair refused at mint; plain `checkpoint` refuses under declared policy | `mint_refuses_sub_quorum_and_undeclared_witnesses` |
| forged cosig → `Tampered{bad_signature}` (verify_run + Auditor) | `verify_run_flags_a_bad_witness_signature` |
| unresolvable witness key → `SignerUnavailable` (custody gap, never a pass); view degrades `unverified` | `witness_resolver_gap_is_a_custody_refusal_not_a_pass` |
| cosigs over a rotated corpus (post-rotation note + chain) | `witnessed_rotation_cosigns_the_post_rotation_note_and_chains` |
| shared check defect vocabulary | `cosignature_check_defects_map_honestly` (Undeclared/QuorumUnmet/Malformed) |
| receipt lift: durable row, fixed `unverified` status, idempotence, audit fold `bound` | `receipt_lifts_durable_unverified_and_binds_the_effect` |
| unknown effect / bad observed_ref / shape refusals — typed, nothing durable | `receipt_refusals_are_typed_never_silent` |
| a row claiming `verified` never parses (the kernel made no such claim) | `receipt_codec_round_trips_and_refuses_claimed_verification` |
| gc/redact durable-before-delete alongside the new rows; `content_refs.gc` accounting | `gc_and_redact_stay_durable_before_delete_alongside_new_rows` |
| boundary: `lab.receipt.record` typed op (missing members, UnknownEffect, malformed attestation, read-only session, no fabricated rows) | embed `lab_receipt_record_is_a_typed_boundary_op` |
| boundary: `serves_measurement` gate | embed `lab_receipt_record_needs_the_measurement_capability` |

Post-`final` receipts need no dedicated cell: `kind=final` requires
`lifecycle.run.finished` committed and `emit_system` refuses
`RunFinished` — the lift is structurally impossible after close (the
refusal path is exercised by the boundary read-only/unknown-effect legs
above).
